idea-plugin.name: DataFrame Viewer & Charting Studio
idea-plugin.description:
📊 DataFrame Viewer & 2D Charting Studio

Flagship high-performance tabular dataset viewer and 2D vector charting engine for Jörmungandr.

  • Multi-Tab Studio: Grid View, interactive 2D Vector Chart View, and Column Profiler
  • 2D Vector Charts: Bar, Line, Scatter, and Histogram charts with live hover inspection and PNG export
  • Statistical Profiling: Quartiles (Q25, Q50, Q75), IQR, variance, skewness, distribution histograms
  • Dynamic Filter Builder: Compound AND/OR conditions across 13 comparison operators
  • Data Transformations: SQL-style groupBy aggregations and Pandas-like describe()
  • Code Generator: Instant export to Pandas, Polars, and SQL DDL + Inserts scripts
  • Heatmap Rendering: Percentile gradient background highlighting for numeric cells
